Open the desktop app to play games.
A friendlier way to enjoy Mednafen.

Emulation belongs to the original Mednafen project and its contributors. GameTranslate adds the library, settings interface, translations and in-app window integration for everyday players. The Mednafen emulator binary is unchanged.
This is an independent frontend, not an official Mednafen release. The original authors retain ownership of their code.
Enjoying it? Thank the original creators.
Give the upstream project a star on GitHub. This opens the original project; starring is your choice.
Mednafen includes work from many emulator and library authors. The upstream credits document is the authoritative list of individual copyright notices and licenses.

The distribution includes the corresponding Mednafen source and license notices. The window adapter is separate GameTranslate code; it forwards to the unchanged SDL library. No games or BIOS files are included.
Mednafen đã dừng. Xem chi tiết trong nhật ký.
